config.note: measured after the tANS warp-kernel rework (packed lane broadcast, 32-bit bit layer, rolled serial section above 8 lanes, coalesced symbol store, owner-only head/tail lookups, prefix-sum decode fast path at 4 lanes and up). benchmarks/tans_interleaved_cuda.json is the baseline.
config.variance: single run, best of 5 per configuration. The RTX 2080 Ti idles at 300 MHz and boosts to 2100 MHz, so a standalone run of one configuration can be about 2.5x slower than the same configuration inside a long matrix run; rANS (untouched by the rework) reproduces benchmarks/tans_interleaved_cuda.json within 1-3 percent here.
